en_value: • Behavioral Finance • Asset Pricing • Corporate Finance | Yen-Cheng Chang is the University Excelsior Chair, College of Management Chen Hong-Mo Chair, and Professor of Finance at National Taiwan University (NTU). He is also the SinoPac Financial Holdings Professor in the School of Political Science and Economics (SPE) at NTU. Previously, he was an assistant professor at the Shanghai Advanced Institute of Finance. His research interests include behavioral finance and econometric identification across finance, accounting, and economics, with publications in leading journals including the Journal of Finance, Review of Financial Studies (x2), The Accounting Review, and the Contemporary Accounting Research. Professor Chang is an Associate Editor at the Journal of Financial Studies and a Director of the Taiwan Finance Association. His research has received the NSTC Outstanding Research Award, E.Sun Academic Awards, NTU Distinguished Academic Publications Award, among others. For his teaching, he has received the NTU Distinguished Teaching Award, NTU Outstanding Teaching Award (x3), and NTU College of Management Outstanding Teaching Award (x6).
